info.name: Inspection App API
info.description:
Complete REST API collection for the Warehouse Inspection Application.

**How to use**
1. Import this collection into Postman.
2. Set the `baseUrl` variable to your server (default: `http://localhost:8080`).
3. Run **Auth / Login** first — the test script automatically saves the JWT to the `token` variable.
4. All subsequent requests inherit Bearer authentication from the collection level.
5. Create requests (POST) auto-save the new resource `id` into the matching variable (e.g. `warehouseId`) so downstream requests are pre-filled.

**Execution order for a clean environment**
```
Auth/Login → Users/Create → Warehouses/Create → Locations/Create
  → Articles/Create → Inspections/Create → Damage Reports/Create
```

item.name: Health
item.description: Public liveness probe — no authentication required.

request.description:
Returns the application status.

**Expected response — 200 OK**
```json
{
  "status": "UP",
  "message": "Inspection App Backend is running"
}
```

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints. The login request is the only public entry point of the API that returns a JWT.

request.description:
Authenticates a user and returns a signed JWT.
The test script automatically saves the token into the `token` collection variable.

**Expected response — 200 OK**
```json
{
  "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9...",
  "type": "Bearer",
  "username": "admin",
  "role": "ADMIN"
}
```

**Failure — 401 Unauthorized** (wrong credentials)
```json
{
  "status": 401,
  "message": "Bad credentials",
  "timestamp": "2026-07-24T10:00:00Z"
}
```

**Failure — 400 Bad Request** (missing or blank fields)
```json
{
  "status": 400,
  "message": "Validation failed",
  "errors": ["Username is required"]
}
```

exec: console.log('Token saved for user:', json.username, '| Role:', json.role);

item.name: Users
item.description: CRUD for user accounts. Requires `ADMIN` role for mutating operations in a production setup (enforced at the service layer).

request.description:
Returns all users as a list.

**Expected response — 200 OK**
```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "username": "admin",
    "email": "admin@example.com",
    "fullName": "System Admin",
    "role": "ADMIN",
    "createdAt": "2026-07-24T10:00:00Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-07-24T10:00:00Z"
  }
]
```

item.name: GET All users filtered by role

request.description:
Filters users by role. Accepted values: `ADMIN`, `INSPECTOR`.

**Expected response — 200 OK** — subset of users array matching the given role.

Fetch a single user by their database ID.

**Expected response — 200 OK**
```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "username": "admin",
  "email": "admin@example.com",
  "fullName": "System Admin",
  "role": "ADMIN",
  "createdAt": "2026-07-24T10:00:00Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-07-24T10:00:00Z"
}
```

**Failure — 404 Not Found** if the ID does not exist.

Creates a new user. The password is hashed with BCrypt before storage — it is never returned in any response.

**Validation rules**
- `username`: required, max 50 chars, only letters/digits/dots/hyphens/underscores
- `email`: required, valid RFC 5322 format, max 100 chars
- `fullName`: required, max 100 chars
- `role`: required enum — `ADMIN` or `INSPECTOR`
- `password`: required, 8–100 chars

**Expected response — 201 Created**
```json
{
  "id": 2,
  "username": "john.doe",
  "email": "john.doe@example.com",
  "fullName": "John Doe",
  "role": "INSPECTOR",
  "createdAt": "2026-07-24T10:00:00Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-07-24T10:00:00Z"
}
```

**Failure — 409 Conflict** if username or email already exists.
**Failure — 400 Bad Request** if validation fails.

Partial update — only the fields included in the request body are applied. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

**Expected response — 200 OK** — the full updated `UserResponse`.

**Failure — 404 Not Found** if the ID does not exist.

item.name: Warehouses
item.description: Warehouse master data. The `code` field is the immutable business key used in barcodes and integrations.

request.description:
Returns all warehouses.

**Expected response — 200 OK**
```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "code": "WH-001",
    "name": "Main Warehouse",
    "address": "123 Industrial Ave",
    "createdAt": "...",
    "updatedAt": "..."
  }
]
```

Case-insensitive substring search on the warehouse name.

**Expected response — 200 OK** — subset of warehouses whose name contains the query string.

Fetch a warehouse by its database ID.

**Expected response — 200 OK** — single `WarehouseResponse`.

**Failure — 404 Not Found** if the ID does not exist.

Creates a new warehouse.

**Validation rules**
- `code`: required, max 50 chars, alphanumeric + hyphens/underscores/dots, must start with letter or digit
- `name`: required, max 100 chars
- `address`: optional; if provided, must be 1–255 chars (not blank)

**Expected response — 201 Created** — the created `WarehouseResponse`.

**Failure — 409 Conflict** if the code already exists.

Partially updates a warehouse. The `code` is immutable.

**Expected response — 200 OK** — updated `WarehouseResponse`.

Permanently deletes a warehouse and all its locations (cascade).

**Expected response — 204 No Content** — empty body.

item.name: Locations
item.description: Aisle/shelf/bay locations within a warehouse. `warehouseId` is required for listing; the composite key (code + warehouseId) is unique.

request.description:

**Expected response — 200 OK**
```json
[

    "id": 1,
    "code": "AISLE-A1",
    "description": "Electronics shelf",
    "warehouseId": 1,
    "warehouseCode": "WH-001",
    "createdAt": "...",
    "updatedAt": "..."
  }
]
```

item.name: Articles
item.description: Inventory article master data. The `code` field is the immutable SKU/EAN barcode.

request.description:
Returns all articles.

**Expected response — 200 OK** — array of `ArticleResponse`.

Case-insensitive search across both `code` and `name` fields.

**Expected response — 200 OK** — filtered array.

Fetch a single article by database ID.

**Expected response — 200 OK** — single `ArticleResponse`.

**Failure — 404 Not Found**.

Creates an article with a unique barcode/SKU code.

**Validation rules**
- `code`: required, max 50 chars, must start with a letter or digit, alphanumeric + hyphens/underscores/dots only (barcode-safe)
- `name`: required, max 100 chars
- `description`: optional, max 500 chars

**Expected response — 201 Created** — the created `ArticleResponse`.

**Failure — 409 Conflict** if the code already exists.

item.name: Inspections
item.description: Warehouse inspection lifecycle management. Supports filtering by warehouse, inspector, and status. Includes a dedicated PATCH endpoint for status transitions.

request.description:
Returns all inspections without filters.

**Expected response — 200 OK** — array of `InspectionResponse`.

Each item includes denormalised fields (`warehouseCode`, `inspectorName`, `damageReportCount`) for list views.

Returns inspections for a specific warehouse.

**Expected response — 200 OK** — filtered array.

Returns all inspections assigned to a specific inspector.

**Expected response — 200 OK** — filtered array.

Returns inspections in the given status. Accepted values: `PLANNED`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `COMPLETED`, `CANCELLED`.

**Expected response — 200 OK** — filtered array.

Fetch a single inspection with full detail.

**Expected response — 200 OK**
```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "inspectionCode": "INSP-2026-001",
  "warehouseId": 1,
  "warehouseCode": "WH-001",
  "inspectorId": 2,
  "inspectorName": "John Doe",
  "status": "PLANNED",
  "scheduledDate": "2026-08-01",
  "notes": "Annual audit",
  "damageReportCount": 0,
  "createdAt": "...",
  "updatedAt": "..."
}
```

Creates a new inspection in `PLANNED` status.

**Validation rules**
- `inspectionCode`: required, globally unique, alphanumeric + hyphens/underscores/dots
- `warehouseId`: required, must exist
- `inspectorId`: required, must exist and have `INSPECTOR` or `ADMIN` role
- `scheduledDate`: required, must be today or in the future (`@FutureOrPresent`)
- `notes`: optional, max 500 chars

**Expected response — 201 Created** — the created `InspectionResponse`.

**Failure — 409 Conflict** if `inspectionCode` already exists.
**Failure — 400 Bad Request** if `scheduledDate` is in the past.

item.name: Damage Reports
item.description: Damage observations recorded during an inspection. Either `inspectionId` or `articleId` is required to list — omitting both returns 400.

request.description:
Returns all damage reports for a given inspection.

**Expected response — 200 OK**
```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "inspectionId": 1,
    "inspectionCode": "INSP-2026-001",
    "articleId": 1,
    "articleCode": "SKU-LT-001",
    "articleName": "Laptop 15-inch",
    "locationId": 1,
    "locationCode": "AISLE-A1",
    "severity": "MEDIUM",
    "description": "Screen cracked",
    "photoUrl": null,
    "createdAt": "...",
    "updatedAt": "..."
  }
]
```

Returns all damage reports for a given article across all inspections — useful for damage history per item.

**Expected response — 200 OK** — array of `DamageReportResponse`.

Negative test: omitting both `inspectionId` and `articleId` must return 400.

**Expected response — 400 Bad Request**

Fetch a single damage report.

**Expected response — 200 OK** — single `DamageReportResponse`.

body.raw:
{
  "inspectionId": {{inspectionId}},
  "articleId": {{articleId}},
  "locationId": {{locationId}},
  "severity": "MEDIUM",
  "description": "Screen has a 3cm crack on the lower-left corner. Device powers on but display is partially obscured.",
  "photoUrl": null
}

request.description:
Records a damage observation. All three FK references are immutable after creation.

**Validation rules**
- `inspectionId`, `articleId`, `locationId`: all required and must exist in the database
- `severity`: required enum — `LOW`, `MEDIUM`, `HIGH`, `CRITICAL`
- `description`: required, max 1000 chars
- `photoUrl`: optional, max 500 chars

**Expected response — 201 Created** — the created `DamageReportResponse`.

Updates the mutable observation fields. The inspection, article, and location are immutable.

**Expected response — 200 OK** — updated `DamageReportResponse`.

Permanently deletes a damage report.

**Expected response — 204 No Content**.
